# VAI_PROG — Vadim Khristenko

> Developer, bot creator and open-source activist. Systems code, Rust, networking, self-hosting. Building vai-rice.space and a set of small Rust→WebAssembly apps.

Vadim Khristenko (handle **VAI_PROG**) is a young developer from Russia. He works across
systems programming (Rust, WASM), web (Astro, Vue, TypeScript), networking / VPN and
Telegram bots, and is active in open source. Winner of the **PROD** olympiad.

Languages: Russian (native), English, Chinese content available across the site.

## Contact
- Email: business@vai-rice.space
- GitHub: https://github.com/Vadim-Khristenko
- Website: https://vai-rice.space

## Mini-apps (Rust + Leptos → WebAssembly)
- [Horizon 2027](https://vai-rice.space/files/horizon/): interactive, branching New Year experience with a live countdown (Gregorian + Chinese New Year).
- [JustCode](https://vai-rice.space/files/justcode/): turn source code into beautiful shareable images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG).
- [VAI Terminal](https://vai-rice.space/files/terminal/): an explorable command-line portfolio with a writable virtual filesystem; speaks bash and PowerShell.

## Selected projects
- tedu-notes.ru — free IT & programming notes platform.
- VIA by VOLT — Telegram community bot (Rust).
- Kumir 3 — the "Kumir" educational language, rewritten in Rust.
- AmneziaWG architect — WireGuard-compatible VPN deployment automation.
